originalTitle: New York sues Kalshi for allegedly running an ‘illegal gambling operation’

content: New York is suing Kalshi over claims the prediction market is running “an illegal gambling operation.” In the lawsuit, New York Attorney General Letitia James accuses Kalshi of violating state laws by accepting wagers without a license from the state’s gaming commission, as reported earlier by CNBC. An investigation from the Office of the Attorney General (OAG) found Kalshi exposes New York residents “to serious personal and financial risk,” including people under the legal gambling age of 21, the lawsuit alleges. The state asks the court to block Kalshi — which is headquartered in New York — from operating in the state and to pay restitution to customers who placed bets on the platform. New York joins Nevada, New Mexico, Arizona, Washington, and others in suing Kalshi. Though some states, such as Wisconsin, Illinois, and Rhode Island, have attempted to introduce laws regulating Kalshi and other prediction markets like Polymarket, they have faced pushback from the federal government. The Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) says it has “exclusive jurisdiction” over prediction markets, but many states argue this authority doesn’t apply to sports wagering. “It’s sad to see this type of political theater from the leadership in our own state,” Elisabeth Diana, Kalshi’s head of communications, said in an emailed statement to The Verge. “This would also hurt New Yorkers, who would be driven offshore.” Beyond state gambling laws, Kalshi has also sparked concerns about insider trading. Earlier this month, ABC News reported that President Donald Trump’s teleprompter operator made $100,000 placing bets on Kalshi related to Trump’s speeches.
chineseTitle: 纽约起诉卡尔希涉嫌经营“非法赌博业务”
chineseSummary: 纽约正在起诉卡尔希，称其预测市场正在进行“非法赌博业务”。据 CNBC 早些时候报道，纽约州总检察长利蒂西亚·詹姆斯 (Letitia James) 在诉讼中指控卡尔希在未经州博彩委员会许可的情况下接受投注，违反了州法律。检察官办公室的一项调查 […]
chineseContent: 纽约正在起诉卡尔希，称其预测市场正在进行“非法赌博业务”。据 CNBC 早些时候报道，纽约州总检察长 Letitia James 在诉讼中指控 Kalshi 在未经州博彩委员会许可的情况下接受投注，违反了州法律。诉讼称，总检察长办公室 (OAG) 的一项调查发现，卡尔希使纽约居民面临“严重的个人和财务风险”，其中包括 21 岁以下合法赌博年龄的人。该州要求法院阻止总部位于纽约的 Kalshi 在该州运营，并向在该平台下注的客户支付赔偿金。纽约与内华达州、新墨西哥州、亚利桑那州、华盛顿州和其他州一起起诉卡尔希。尽管威斯康星州、伊利诺伊州和罗德岛州等一些州试图出台监管 Kalshi 和 Polymarket 等其他预测市场的法律，但它们面临着联邦政府的阻力。商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）表示，它对预测市场拥有“专属管辖权”，但许多州认为这一权力不适用于体育博彩。卡尔希的通讯主管伊丽莎白·戴安娜 (Elisabeth Diana) 在发给 The Verge 的电子邮件声明中表示：“看到我们州领导层上演这种政治戏剧，我们感到很难过。” “这也会伤害纽约人，他们将被赶到海外。”除了州赌博法之外，卡尔希还引发了人们对内幕交易的担忧。本月早些时候，美国广播公司新闻报道称，唐纳德·特朗普总统的提词器操作员在卡尔希身上押注了与特朗普演讲相关的 10 万美元。
